create_runner_subclass: create a subclass of Runner that implements run, save_state, and load_state abstract methods
test_mockrunner: test MockRunner by instantiating with x, y, z values and calling run to get their sum
use_preemptablemixin: use PreemptableMixin with a Runner subclass to add STOPFAIR preemption and atomic checkpointing support
save_checkpoint_atomic: save an atomic checkpoint by calling PreemptableMixin save_state which writes to a temp dir then renames
handle_stopfair_preemption: handle STOPFAIR preemption by calling handle_stopfair to save state and raise StopfairDetected exception
